facts.text: I've been getting short of breath.
It started about a month ago.
I have a 30 pack-year smoking history.
Three months ago I was diagnosed with rheumatoid arthritis.
My arthritis has improved since I started the treatment.
Three months ago I started bucillamine, 200 mg a day, for my arthritis.
At the same time I started prednisolone, 4 mg a day.
I had my mitral valve replaced a year ago.

findings.result: No signs of congestive heart failure.

findings.result: Fine crackles over both lower lung fields.

findings.name: autoimmune serology
findings.result: Rheumatoid factor 352 IU/mL; anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody ≥1,200 U/mL; other autoantibodies normal or negative.

findings.result: PaO2 87.2 mmHg on 3 L/min nasal oxygen.

findings.name: pulmonary function tests
findings.result: Vital capacity 1.11 L (53.9% predicted); FVC 1.08 L (52.4% predicted); FEV1 1.03 L (77.4% predicted); DLCO 2.23 mL/min/mmHg (17.7% predicted).

findings.name: chest radiograph
findings.result: Infiltrative opacities with reticular shadows in the bilateral middle and lower lung fields.

findings.name: high-resolution chest CT
findings.result: Ground-glass opacities and consolidations in both lungs, sparing the lung bases, along with reticular opacities, honeycombing and traction bronchiectasis in the lower lobes, consistent with pre-existing usual interstitial pneumonia.

findings.name: bronchoalveolar lavage cell analysis
findings.result: 2.45×10^5 cells/mL: macrophages 44.0%, lymphocytes 25.5%, neutrophils 26.0%, eosinophils 4.5%; CD4/CD8 ratio 0.2.

findings.name: transbronchial lung biopsy
findings.result: Alveolar organizing pneumonia, septal thickening and inflammatory cell infiltration.

gold.reasoning: 1. Infection was considered but excluded because “No microorganisms were detected in a BALF culture.” 2. Congestive heart failure was considered but deemed unlikely given that “No physical findings suggestive of congestive heart failure (pitting edema of the lower extremities and jugular venous distention) were observed,” and cardiac biomarkers were normal. 3. Acute exacerbation of pre-existing ILD was considered but judged less likely since “The most common histologic pattern of AE of chronic ILD is DAD; less commonly, patients have OP …” and the patient’s presentation showed an OP pattern temporally related to bucillamine initiation.

leakage.reason: The patient's own medication (bucillamine) is part of the gold diagnosis name; the drug history is essential and the patient knows the drug.
The lymphocyte stimulation test result names bucillamine as the tested drug (negative).

source_issues: A negative bucillamine lymphocyte stimulation test (stimulation index 168%) is reported, yet the diagnosis is bucillamine-induced pneumonitis.
notes: Index visit: the referral for 1 month of progressive dyspnea (s001-s016); the crackles and chest radiograph from before bucillamine was started (s004) are earlier findings with time.

Interstitial lung changes (crackles and reticular shadows) were present before bucillamine was started, so the new process sits on pre-existing fibrosis (HRCT: consistent with pre-existing usual interstitial pneumonia).
Everything in s011 is reported jointly as 'normal or negative'; each test returns that state.
